text:
deploy-bot: START ROLLOUT service-x blue->green eu-west weight=10% at 2026-03-17T14:12:03Z (4456789123)
alice_infra: seeing 502/504 spike from eu-west canaries, error rate jumped to ~12% :rotating_light:
sam_oncall: oncall here, looking now. paging in.
incident-bot: Pager duty: sam_oncall assigned to incident INC-4456 (severity: high)
maria_support: getting customer tickets about timeouts in EU region, initial triage says requests timing out at edge
netops: DNS looks weird — some resolvers showing 50/50 weight while others still at 100% green IPs, TTL 300
alice_infra: nginx upstream logs show connect_timeout to model-backend-green cluster
sam_oncall: pausing rollout. marking canary as failed. initiating feature-flag kill-switch: ff/service-x/bluegreen=false
deploy-bot: Kill-switch accepted. Halting traffic shift and starting rollback to blue at 14:18:01Z
ops_lead: confirm no DB migrations or schema changes in this release? need go/no-go on immediate rollback
maria_support: confirmed — no schema changes, safe to rollback fully
sam_oncall: running rollback steps now. executing health checks on blue pods:
```
curl -sSf https://eu-west.service-x.internal/_health || echo FAIL
kubectl rollout status deployment/service-x-blue -n prod
```
netops: note — cache TTL means some clients may still hit green IP for a few minutes; purging CDN edge caches now
maria_support: support update queued to customers: "We observed transient errors during a canary rollout to EU; traffic has been reverted and we're monitoring"
incident-bot: Change recorded: rollback started by sam_oncall (action id: RB-4456)
alice_infra: after rollback most 502s dropped, overall error rate back to baseline but one POP (AMS) still shows elevated 5xx for ~3% of requests
sam_oncall: isolating AMS POP: added temporary routing rule to favor blue origin for AMS, monitoring
taylor_oncall: taking handoff from sam in 30m. sam, please summarize current state for next on-call
sam_oncall: summary: rollout halted at +6m due to upstream connect failures in green. Kill-switch flipped, full rollback initiated. Customer impact: ~3% of EU requests experienced errors for ~6-9 minutes. Mitigations: rollback, CDN purge, AMS routing override. Follow-ups: DNS resolver cache variance, investigate green backend health (network/connectivity) and canary gating logic.
ops_lead: good. open a P0 postmortem ticket and attach timeline, canary metrics, and DNS samples. assign to eng-runtime and netops
incident-bot: Incident INC-4456 status: mitigated -> monitoring. auto-pager cleared.
maria_support: final tally: 14 customer tickets opened, all transient, CS notified customers that service is restored
alice_infra: will collect canary traces and attach to the incident. initial hypothesis: green backend had intermittent egress to model storage region causing connect timeouts
taylor_oncall: acknowledged. I'll take point on follow-up tomorrow and run a dry-run of the gating thresholds to prevent partial-weight drift. :thumbsup:
netops: leaving a note — consider lowering DNS TTL during rollout windows and add resolver-consistency check to rollout script
incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) at 14:14:30Z (4456789270)
alice_infra: will post full incident writeup in #postmortems with timeline and remediation actions
